import importlib,json,sys,time,os,hashlib
import ibex_pyarrow
from pathlib import Path
import polars as pl
from polars.testing import assert_frame_equal
from ibex_polars import IbexEngine
sys.path.insert(0,"/home/brj/code/polars-benchmark")
root=Path("/home/brj/code/polars-benchmark/data/tables/scale-10.0")
query=importlib.import_module("queries.polars.q12").q(lineitem=pl.scan_parquet(root/"lineitem.parquet"),orders=pl.scan_parquet(root/"orders.parquet"))
engine=IbexEngine().prepare(query)
source=engine.explain(query)
bridge_hash=hashlib.sha256(Path(ibex_pyarrow.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
previous=None
for line in sys.stdin:
 route=line.strip()
 start=time.perf_counter_ns()
 result=query.collect(engine=engine if route=="ibex" else "streaming")
 elapsed=(time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6
 previous=result
 print(json.dumps({"ms":elapsed,"rows":result.rows(),"schema":str(result.schema),"source":source,"bridge_sha256":bridge_hash}),flush=True)
